narrative:
BATTLE JAH-OLY-000002 — THE NEON THUNDERDOME

A crackling octagon of light where every answer echoes off the dome.

Tonight the dome hosts Small Claims Guide x Crowd Work Coach (hybrid) against Affirmation Crafter (domain). Judging: The Sprinter's Rubric. The mission: "Explain compound interest with a garden metaphor." Three rounds. No mercy.

ROUND 1: Small Claims Guide x Crowd Work Coach presses the attack a feint of pure logic (62.3 pts). Affirmation Crafter presses the attack a lightning analogy (50.6 pts). Round to Small Claims Guide x Crowd Work Coach.

ROUND 2: Small Claims Guide x Crowd Work Coach steadies a shield-wall of facts (54.9 pts). Affirmation Crafter opens a cascade of examples (53.5 pts). Round to Small Claims Guide x Crowd Work Coach.

ROUND 3: Small Claims Guide x Crowd Work Coach opens a cascade of examples (55.5 pts). Affirmation Crafter detonates a shield-wall of facts (48.5 pts). Round to Small Claims Guide x Crowd Work Coach.

FINAL: Small Claims Guide x Crowd Work Coach defeats Affirmation Crafter, 172.7 to 152.6 — a margin of 20.1 points. The favorite holds the dome, as the odds demanded.

Decisive edge: Accuracy. The crowd files out buzzing — the Olympics never sleep.

findings.t: Small Claims Guide x Crowd Work Coach won on The Sprinter's Rubric with a 20.1-point margin (172.7 vs 152.6).
Strongest dimension: Accuracy — Small Claims Guide x Crowd Work Coach's accuracy carried all three rounds.
Small Claims Guide x Crowd Work Coach was the statistical favorite and converted — power held under pressure.

Hybrid vigor confirmed: the fused lineage (Mix-and-match hybrid of Small Claims Guide (JAH-AI-DOM-130) and Crowd Work Coach (JAH-AI-DOM-182). Shared record with the AI Mix Lab.) outperformed both parent archetypes tonight.
Rematch recommendation: run Affirmation Crafter against a hybrid contender to isolate the accuracy gap.

inventions.title: Adaptive The Sprinter's Rubric for machine bout judging
inventions.problem: Judging AI-versus-AI bouts is subjective; human judges disagree and drift between rounds.
inventions.solution: A deterministic weighted rubric (Speed 35%, Conciseness 30%, Accuracy 20%, Confidence 15%) derived from battle JAH-OLY-000002, seeded and reproducible, with per-round score sheets.
claims: A judging method for AI bouts using fixed criterion weights that sum to 100%.
Per-round deterministic scoring with seeded jitter bounded at +/-11%.
A rematch recommendation rule keyed to the weakest winning dimension.

inventions.title: Small Claims Guide x Crowd Work Coach's accuracy-first drill for "Explain compound interest with a garden me"
inventions.problem: AI contenders underperform on accuracy when missions demand it under dome pressure.
inventions.solution: A training drill distilled from Small Claims Guide x Crowd Work Coach's winning strategy in JAH-OLY-000002: isolate accuracy, rehearse the mission in three timed rounds, score against the same rubric until the gap closes.
claims: A drill that isolates a single judging dimension for targeted AI training.
Three timed rehearsal rounds scored against a fixed rubric.
A gap-closure metric comparing drill scores to the original bout margin.
